question: By whose agency and to what extent was the yoginī named Icchā transmitted?
premises: It extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The siddhas transmitted the yoginī Icchā up to the limit of māyā by supreme will
uncertainties: The exact sense of transmission up to māyā is doctrinally compressed
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā was transmitted by the siddhas up to the limit of māyā, by supreme will.
